{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert customer_segment to lowercase for consistency
data['customer_segment'] = data['customer_segment'].str.lower()

# Remove commas from revenue strings to make them valid for float parsing
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
revenue_numeric = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Replace the original revenue column with the cleaned numeric version
data['revenue'] = revenue_numeric

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
df_loyal_completed = data[(data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
